Vv 


February 12, 1971 
For release at will 


BIG BUSINESS BACKS 
YMCA FUND DRIVE 

Headed by Dominion Glass President E+ A+ Thompson, 
a hard hitting team of business leaders has been recruited 
for the Corporate and Special Names portion of the Montreal 
YMCA financial campaign for $400,000. 

This vital part of the drive has been sub-divided 
into nine sections: Basic Resources, Commerce, Individuals, 
Manufacturing, Transport & Oil, Finance, Food and Beverages, 
Employee Funds, Service Industries. 

Proceeds of the campaign, to run March 8th-20th, 
are expected to provide approximately 13 per cent of the 
Y"s operating budget of nearly $3,000,000. The largest 
part of this total is generated through membership and 
paid services. 

Campaign funds finance programs with little 
revenue potential, but which touch the lives of some 
30,000 people of all ages. 

-30- 
For further information please contact:
